title: Measuring Inclusion in Interaction: Inclusion Analytics for Human-AI Collaborative Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Inequality of Participation (IP) using turn counts and word counts to measure conversational floor access and participation imbalance among group members.
Measuring politeness uptake by computing the cosine similarity of 11 predefined politeness strategy vectors to evaluate whether respectful interactional norms are reciprocated or marginalized.

Evaluating whose contributions are legitimized by measuring semantic-based idea uptake (using Sentence-BERT embeddings to track idea propagation) and endorsement-based uptake (using regex matching for explicit agreement).
Comparing interactional inclusion metrics (participation rates, politeness uptake, and idea endorsement) between human participants and AI teammates within mixed collaborative problem-solving teams.
